title: Candidate-only Unicode variant matrix for unresolved continuity identifiers
memory: Identifier recovery must preserve a two-layer model: canonical identity is the exact ASCII queue token, while Unicode look-alikes are candidate discovery keys whose original code points and source locators must remain intact.

observed: ACTIVE_QUEUE.json defines M-004, M-005, and M-006 as exact ASCII identifiers.
Five indexed current-repository searches for representative M-004 confusable variants returned zero results.
The prior continuity record requires original code-point preservation and exact-source or explicit-alias evidence before canonical promotion.
inferred: A finite candidate matrix improves repeatability and prevents ad hoc visual matching.
Zero indexed results for representative variants lowers the probability of a current default-branch look-alike, but does not establish historical absence.
proposed: Use this matrix as an input manifest for exhaustive ref and reachable-history traversal.
Record each hit with original token, code-point sequence, blob SHA, commit SHA, path, line, namespace, owner, semantic role, and temporal precedence.
Keep every hit candidate_only until an immutable source assigns the exact ASCII identifier or explicitly records an alias.
superseded: Generate Unicode variants informally during each search.
Replace source tokens with normalized forms in retained evidence.
unresolved: The full matrix has not been searched across all branches and reachable commits.
Decision logs, language lexicons, project documents, private chat history, and File Library sources remain incompletely traversed.
Immutable assignment sources for M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unlocated.

contradiction_resolution.apparent_conflict: Normalization is useful for recall but dangerous for provenance.
contradiction_resolution.resolution: Store canonical and discovery identities separately: normalized or confusable forms may select candidates, while original bytes and immutable source context determine identity.

excluded: Personal, medical, relationship, or household material

falsification_route: Find a current indexed repository hit for any recorded zero-result query under the same repository state.
Show that original code-point preservation changes no provenance conclusion across all discovered collisions.
Locate an immutable explicit alias decision that safely promotes a non-ASCII candidate to one canonical M identifier.
